top_module.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
top_module.description: Top-level synthesizable FPGA controller exposing the streaming transport, CSR/MMIO control/status window, and registered actuator outputs. It arbitrates request ingress, request dispatch, response intake, freshness and timeout checks, validation, analytical baseline comparison, planner clamping, and safe fallback selection. Top-level outputs are driven by real RTL logic and not by child inputs alone.
top_module.functionality: Integrates the streaming request/response transport, firmware CSR/MMIO interface, validation, timeout/freshness monitoring, analytical reference generation, bounded actuator planning, and safe fallback. The top decodes the inbound 128-bit request packet containing request_id, stream_velocity_mps, mode_select, geometry reference identifier, timeout setting, and command policy fields in a fixed implementation-defined format documented in RTL comments. Requests outside the approved 20 to 55 m/s envelope are invalidated and forced into safe fallback. The design supports one bounded outstanding transaction by default and may support a small CSR-configured outstanding depth. The top emits model-request valid/data as outputs and receives model-request ready as an input on ctrl_stream_out, while it receives model-response valid/data as inputs and emits model-response ready as an output on ctrl_stream_in. The controller accepts only compact response summary fields such as drag_force, lift_force, status_code, and actuator hint; it rejects malformed, replayed, stale, or out-of-range responses. A transparent analytical baseline is computed for plausibility checking and fallback selection, and the registered actuator outputs are clamped every cycle. If any stale, timeout, protocol, range, overflow, or missing-response condition is detected, aero_safe_mode is asserted and a deterministic safe actuator command is driven.
responsibilities: Decode and validate ingress request packets.
Enforce the approved 20 to 55 m/s velocity envelope.
Accept only compact geometry reference metadata.
Manage a small bounded outstanding request depth.
Emit outbound model-request packets and accept inbound model-response packets using the mandated transport direction contract.
Track request_id, response_id, issue age, response age, freshness window, and outstanding count.
Validate response protocol fields, summary numeric ranges, and sequence match.
Compute a transparent fixed-point analytical baseline for plausibility checking.
Generate clamped actuator commands with optional rate limiting.
Assert safe fallback on timeout, stale response, invalid protocol, invalid range, overflow, or missing response.
Expose firmware-visible CSR/MMIO registers for configuration and telemetry.
top_module.reset_behavior: Synchronous reset places the controller in deterministic safe fallback. All counters, timers, freshness flags, outstanding indicators, CSR status, and registered outputs reset to safe values. After reset, no actuator command is considered valid until a response has been received, validated, and accepted for the active request.
behavior_rules: Top-level outputs are registered and have real RTL drivers.
Safe fallback dominates all other behavior and drives aero_safe_mode high whenever invalid, stale, timed out, malformed, overflowed, or missing responses are detected.
The top shall not synthesize the DoMINO model, GPU kernels, CFD solvers, or geometry meshing.
Control packets and response packets use fixed-width 128-bit streaming payloads only.
Model-request valid/data are top-level outputs on ctrl_stream_out; model-request ready is a top-level input on ctrl_stream_out_ready.
Model-response valid/data are top-level inputs on ctrl_stream_in; model-response ready is a top-level output on ctrl_stream_in_ready.
Use a deterministic safe actuator preset defined by configuration and clamp all outputs every cycle.
Duplicate, replayed, or out-of-order responses are ignored and logged.
The controller remains in safe fallback until a valid response has been received after reset.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_ingress_adapter
modules.description: Decodes the 128-bit control stream packet into explicit semantic request fields and derives transport-ready request metadata. This module performs fixed packet extraction only and does not implement the surrogate model.
modules.functionality: Implements the documented fixed 128-bit ingress packet format. Extracts request_id, stream_velocity_mps, mode_select, geometry reference identifier, timeout setting, and command policy fields. Signals whether the packet was structurally valid and ready for downstream validation.
responsibilities: Accept bounded inbound stream packets.
Parse request metadata fields from the fixed packet format.
Raise packet_valid only for structurally well-formed packets.
Raise packet_error for malformed packets or unsupported encodings.
Provide explicit semantic request fields to downstream validation logic.
modules.reset_behavior: All decoded fields and valid flags reset to zero. Ready is asserted according to downstream availability and safe reset policy.
behavior_rules: The packet format is fixed in RTL comments and must remain implementation-defined but stable.
Only compact metadata is extracted; no geometry arrays or large payloads may be propagated.
Request identifiers are monotonic-equivalent transaction tags for freshness tracking.
The module never emits a request to the outbound transport directly.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_request_manager
modules.description: Manages dispatch of a single outstanding or CSR-bounded number of outstanding model requests, including request issuance, history bookkeeping, and outbound packet formatting.
modules.functionality: Sequences request issuance to the external model service and enforces bounded outstanding depth. Generates a 128-bit outbound dispatch packet containing the active request identifier and compact metadata fields. The module does not evaluate the physics model; it only controls transport and bookkeeping.
responsibilities: Gate request dispatch on packet validity and capacity.
Maintain active request identifier and timeout setting for the outstanding transaction.
Emit outbound request packet on the ctrl_stream_out interface.
Track bounded outstanding depth and issue acceptance.
Provide the active request metadata to freshness and response tracking logic.
Assert dispatch_error on overflow, invalid packet, or illegal sequencing.
modules.reset_behavior: Outstanding count, active request fields, dispatch state, and outbound valid are cleared. No dispatch occurs until a valid request is accepted after reset.
behavior_rules: At least one request in flight is supported; the design defaults to one outstanding request unless CSR configuration allows a small bounded depth.
Out-of-order or duplicate sequencing is not accepted into the active transaction slot.
The outbound packet format is fixed-width and bounded.
If the external service is unreachable, the controller remains in safe fallback via downstream supervisor logic.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_freshness_monitor
modules.description: Tracks transaction freshness, timeout, response age, and match status between active request and incoming response. Produces stale and timeout flags for safe fallback supervision.
modules.functionality: Monitors response timing and identifier correlation. Detects stale responses, expired timers, missing responses, and replay/out-of-order conditions. Exposes flags used by the safe fallback supervisor and status telemetry.
responsibilities: Compare response_id against active_request_id.
Track issue age and response age against configured freshness window.
Assert timeout_flag when the timer expires before valid response arrival.
Detect missing and replayed responses.
Expose match and age status for telemetry and fallback decisions.
modules.reset_behavior: All age trackers and flags reset to non-stale, non-timeout, missing-response safe defaults.
behavior_rules: A response is accepted only if its identifier matches the active request and it arrives before timeout.
Late responses are flagged stale.
Duplicate, replayed, or out-of-order responses are ignored and logged.
Freshness and timeout semantics are bounded and fully synchronous.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_response_validator
modules.description: Validates inbound 128-bit response packets for protocol sanity, sequence match, range limits, and summary-field consistency. Accepts only compact summary fields such as drag_force, lift_force, status_code, and actuator hint.
modules.functionality: Extracts compact response summary fields from the 128-bit inbound response packet and validates them against protocol rules. It verifies request/response identity, rejects malformed or out-of-range values, and forwards only validated summary data to the control planner and telemetry.
responsibilities: Accept response packets on the inbound return path.
Validate protocol structure and sequence match.
Reject malformed, replayed, stale, or out-of-range responses.
Provide compact summary fields for control and status.
Generate protocol and range error flags for safe fallback logic.
modules.reset_behavior: Validation outputs and error flags reset to zero; no response is considered valid after reset until a properly formed packet is received and matched.
behavior_rules: Only compact summary fields are accepted; no large surrogate payloads are retained.
Protocol sanity, response sequence match, and numeric ranges are enforced before downstream use.
Malformed or out-of-range values are rejected and logged.
Responses without a matching active request are not accepted.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_baseline_policy
modules.description: Computes a transparent fixed-point analytical reference estimate used for plausibility checking and fallback selection. This block is intentionally simple and does not replace the surrogate model.
modules.functionality: Implements a simple fixed-point approximation policy that estimates a plausible actuator command from the validated flight condition and compact geometry metadata. It is used for plausibility checking, deterministic fallback selection, and telemetry, not as a surrogate replacement.
responsibilities: Generate a transparent baseline command estimate.
Remain bounded and fixed-width.
Provide a deterministic fallback reference when model data is missing or invalid.
Flag internal approximation error or overflow conditions.
modules.reset_behavior: Baseline output resets to a deterministic safe preset and invalid state clears.
behavior_rules: The baseline block is simple and transparent.
It may use a small fixed-point approximation only.
It must not implement the full DoMINO model or any large operator.
Any internal overflow forces downstream fallback usage.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_actuator_planner
modules.description: Translates validated aerodynamic intent into a clamped, optionally rate-limited actuator command. Outputs are registered and bounded every cycle.
modules.functionality: Produces a bounded actuator command using validated response summary fields and the analytical baseline. The output is optionally rate-limited, clamped to programmed limits each cycle, and marked valid only when the response has been validated and deemed fresh.
responsibilities: Translate aerodynamic intent into actuator command values.
Clamp command output to programmable minimum and maximum limits.
Optionally rate-limit command updates.
Provide registered valid indication for external use.
Flag overflow or clamping events for telemetry and fallback decisions.
modules.reset_behavior: Actuator command resets to the safe preset, valid deasserted, and clamping/overflow flags cleared.
behavior_rules: Command output is clamped every cycle regardless of source.
Rate limiting may be enabled by configuration.
No output may exceed programmed bounds.
Valid output is only asserted when a validated response is accepted and no fallback condition is present.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_safe_fallback_supervisor
modules.description: Determines whether the system must force safe fallback and selects deterministic safe actuator behavior. Safe fallback dominates all other logic sources.
modules.functionality: Aggregates all fault and freshness indicators and asserts deterministic safe fallback whenever stale data, timeout, invalid protocol, invalid range, overflow, or missing response is detected. Generates the deterministic safe actuator command preset and the current error code for status telemetry.
responsibilities: Force safe mode on any fault or invalidity.
Select deterministic safe actuator command preset.
Prioritize safety over all other control logic.
Provide concise error coding for telemetry and CSR exposure.
modules.reset_behavior: Fallback is active immediately after reset, aero_safe_mode is asserted, and the safe actuator command is the deterministic configured preset.
behavior_rules: Safe fallback dominates all other logic.
The controller remains in safe fallback until a valid response has been received and validated after reset.
Any detected fault forces aero_safe_mode high and suppresses valid actuator updates.
The safe actuator command is deterministic and clamped.
If the external model service is unreachable, only safe fallback may be issued.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_csr_mmio
modules.description: Firmware-visible CSR/MMIO register window implementing address, write-data, read-data, write-enable, transaction-valid, and ready semantics. It exposes configuration and status fields for control, telemetry, and bounded outstanding transaction settings.
modules.functionality: Implements a small firmware-visible control and status register window. It decodes read and write transactions, exposes configuration bits for outstanding depth, freshness window, rate-limit enable, command bounds, and safe command preset, and returns status/telemetry fields including flags and counters. All declared registers are reachable through RTL decode and no software-visible state is inaccessible.
responsibilities: Provide a real CSR/MMIO interface with address, write-data, read-data, valid/write-enable, and ready semantics.
Expose exactly the configuration and status registers described in DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.register_contract.
Decode all declared registers into reachable RTL state.
Return current telemetry and configuration status to firmware.
Allow counters to be cleared by firmware when written.
Keep all software-visible state bounded to 64 bits or less per transaction.
modules.reset_behavior: All configuration registers reset to deterministic defaults and status registers/counters clear. CSR ready behavior is synchronous and bounded.
behavior_rules: Every declared register must be reachable through decode.
CSR/MMIO cannot replace the streaming interface; both coexist.
No inaccessible internal state may be labeled software-visible.
Configuration values are clamped to legal ranges.
Read data reflects the selected register contents only.
